title: Product safety information shown in the listing
summary: An offer made at a distance must clearly show the manufacturer's identity and contact details, the responsible person where one is required, product identification and any warnings or safety information.

required_data.label: Responsible person shown in the listing

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2023/988 on general product safety
sources.note: Fetched the Publications Office PDF directly. Art. 19, titled 'Obligations of economic operators in the case of distance sales', requires the offer itself to 'clearly and visibly indicate at least': (a) manufacturer's name/trade name/trademark plus postal and electronic address; (b) where the manufacturer is not established in the Union, the responsible person's name, postal and electronic address (cross-referencing Art. 16(1) of this Regulation and Art. 4(1) of Reg. (EU) 2019/1020, which is exactly the rp.name field this draft already models); (c) product identification incl. a picture; (d) warnings/safety information in a language the destination Member State's consumers understand. Citation and required_data both confirmed correct as drafted.
